name: Shannon L. McColley
description: Alternative name entry for Shannon McColley; preserved historical URL.
story: The 2016 and 2018 conference contributions were attributed to Shannon L. McColley. The pre-existing Shannon McColley record already lists the middle-initial form as an alias. The conference authorship and associated links have been consolidated into that established biography.
